title: Review council — correctness
description: Reviewer A's findings, written to review/correctness.json and checked by reviewer B before any of them reach the PR. Read by post-review.mjs, which refuses a file that is missing or does not validate: an empty review is not a clean one.

severity.description: blocking holds the merge. major and minor do not, and any left unfixed become one follow-up issue.

ac.description: The acceptance criterion this breaks, as AC-n, when there is one. A criterion rejected two rounds running sends the work order to root-cause, and this is how the pipeline tells.

verdict.description: Informational. The merged verdict is computed from the findings that survive verification, not taken from here.
